hadith:
Friday Prayer - Narrated Anas bin Malik:

We used to offer the Jumua prayer early and then have an afternoon nap.
message: Every individual has a guardian angel watching over them, recording their deeds. This should remind us to be mindful of our actions at all times. Let us seek guidance from Allah, the Most Righteous Guide, to lead us towards righteousness and truth.
name:
Ar Rasheed - الرَّشِيدُ - The Most Righteous Guide

The name Ar-Rasheed conveys the idea of Allah being the one who leads and guides believers towards the path of righteousness and truth. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'راشد' (r-sh-d), which pertains to guidance and correctness. It appears in various Islamic teachings, emphasizing the importance of seeking guidance from Allah in all aspects of life.
verse:
At-Tariq - The Nightcommer - 86:4

There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺.
